summary: Nomad Foods Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the implementation of a Co-Investment and Share Option Matching Sub Plan under its 2025 Equity Incentive Plan, effective May 5, 2026. The plan grants options to certain directors and senior leaders, including the CEO, CFO, and Co-Chairmen, contingent on their purchase and holding of a specified number of ordinary shares. Options cliff-vest based on share price hurdles ranging from $16.00 to $25.00 or more, with a five-year term and exercisable between the third and fifth anniversaries. This is an equity incentive arrangement, not a special situation like an acquisition or activist campaign.
